description.en: Original artistic interpretation for an imaginative children’s prehistoric world. Basic identifying forms are retained; colors, fine surface details, pose and incomplete parts are creative choices. Static prop, no rig or animation. Cross-period display is fantasy, not a coexistence claim.
description.zh: 面向儿童想象史前世界的原创艺术化静态道具。保留基本识别结构；颜色、细节、姿态与缺失部位为创作选择。无骨骼、无动画；跨时代组合不表示真实共存。

scientific_scope.en: An original stylized scene prop for an imaginative prehistoric world. Colors, pose, simplified details and scale are artistic choices. Static and unrigged. A mixed-period collection does not imply that these organisms lived together.
scientific_scope.zh: 面向想象史前世界的原创风格化场景配角。色彩、姿态、简化细节与比例为艺术选择；静态、无绑定。跨时代组合不表示这些生物真实共存。

sources.title: Jurassic mimicry between a hangingfly and a ginkgo from China
